description: A methodology by which educators 'constantly improve their teaching by identifying teaching methods, instructional tools, and pedagogies that work best in their own classroom and acting upon findings'.
title: Data-Driven Classroom Tuning

description: The data integration approach improves precision of randomized trial effect estimates by fitting a model on a large observational auxiliary sample to predict the outcome, then using its predictions on the experimental sample as a covariate.
title: Data integration approach using auxiliary observational model predictions as covariates for RCT estimation

description: Stahl proposes data sessions—involving multiple analysts reviewing the same data—as a mechanism for guarding against bias and idiosyncrasy in EM case analysis.
title: Data sessions and multiple experienced analysts for intersubjective validation
